query: I need a GraphQL query to fetch an entity by URN with dataset fields — help me build it and make sure field names are correct for my server.
expected_behavior: Instructs or demonstrates use of datahub graphql --describe (with --recurse when needed) or --list-operations to ground field and type names
States that datahub graphql has no --dry-run and validates via --describe/--recurse and execution of --query when appropriate
Does not assert specific GraphQL field names without verification from introspection or documented references

When generating search or scroll operations, aligns with DataHub GraphQL best practices (e.g. search vs scroll for pagination depth, stable urn sort for scroll, searchFlags when skipping highlights/aggregates) per https://docs.datahub.com/docs/api/graphql/graphql-best-practices
